headline: Rank 1: Alem Leather Works PLC scores 92/100 points under investment readiness track
whyThisRank: Alem Leather Works PLC ranks 1st in the batch by achieving the highest total score of 92 points while meeting all eligibility requirements. It was evaluated under the investment readiness track (7b) based on its equipment requests.
justification: Alem Leather Works PLC leads the evaluation batch with an overall score of 92 out of 100 points and full eligibility compliance. The business secured maximum points across job creation potential (25 new jobs), expected intervention results, sales growth (58.1%), international market presence, management capacity, and green sector impact. Lower scores occurred in youth employment (25.8%), local raw material share (70%), and product uniqueness. No material findings were flagged during evaluation.
strengths: Full points earned for job creation potential (25 new jobs) on the investment readiness track (7b).
Strong sales growth of 58.1% (2023 to 2024) alongside international market reach.
Maximum points awarded for positive social and environmental impact via a green sector marker.
40% female business ownership and 4 designated core management team members.
watchouts: Youth employment share is 25.8%, yielding 2 out of 5 points for criterion 5.3.
Local raw material share is 70%, yielding 3 out of 5 points for criterion 4.
Product uniqueness scored 3 out of 5 points as the product/service is not new to Ethiopia.
